description: Run twelve deterministic checks against the outside of a public web app and return a dated verdict: the stamp, the open/closed/not-checked counts, every line with its plain-English consequence, what was skipped, and the receipt id and URL. Free, no token. It reads public pages only: it does not sign in, does not create an account and does not guess anything. A clean verdict is not a guarantee of safety.

url.description: The app to check, e.g. https://example.com

name: scan_app
title: Check a web app before shipping it
